{"content": "Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation — June 10–20, 2024

Trip Overview
- Destination: Hawaii
- Dates: June 10th – June 20th, 2024
- Key Activities: Beach day at Waikiki, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay, hiking at Diamond Head, Pearl Harbor visit, North Shore road trip, luau at Polynesian Cultural Center, spa day, kayaking at Kailua Beach, shopping at Ala Moana Center

Packing List

Clothing
- Swimwear (2–3 sets)
- Casual outfits / t-shirts and shorts
- Light jacket or sweater (evenings and air-conditioning)
- One nice outfit (for the luau / dinners)
- Undergarments and socks
- Sleepwear
- Hat or cap (sun protection)
- Sunglasses

Footwear
- Comfortable walking shoes / sneakers
- Hiking shoes or sturdy trail shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Sandals / flip-flops
- Water shoes (for kayaking and beach)

Beach & Water Gear
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear or mask (for Hanauma Bay)
- Waterproof phone pouch / dry bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach bag
- Swim goggles

Hiking & Outdoor
- Hiking gear (daypack, moisture-wicking clothing)
- Reusable water bottle
- Bug spray / insect repellent
- Small first-aid kit
- Energy snacks

Toiletries & Personal
- Toothbrush, toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Deodorant
- Razor and shaving cream
- Skincare and moisturizer
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hair ties / brush
- Personal medications
- Aloe vera / after-sun lotion

Electronics
- Camera (for sightseeing and the road trip)
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Headphones

Travel Documents & Essentials
- Travel documents (ID, passport if applicable, tickets)
- Hotel and itinerary confirmations
- Credit cards / cash
- Driver's license (for the North Shore road trip rental car)
- Small backpack or day bag
- Luggage locks
- Reusable shopping bag (for Ala Moana Center)

Notes
- Pack light, breathable fabrics suited to warm, humid weather.
- Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect Hawaii's marine life.
- Comfortable shoes are essential for the Diamond Head hike.
- Leave a little extra room for souvenirs from Ala Moana Center.
", "filename": "hawaii-packing-list.docx"}

Emma Johnson's Vacation — June 10th to June 20th, 2024

Hiking (Diamond Head)

- Light daypack
- Hat and sunglasses
- Sunscreen and water bottle

Sightseeing & Road Trip (Pearl Harbor, North Shore)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Daypack
- Camera
- Portable charger

Luau (Polynesian Cultural Center)
- Smart-casual outfit

Spa & Relaxation Day

Kayaking (Kailua Beach)

Shopping (Ala Moana Center)

- Book or e-reader for travel days and relaxation
- Reusable shopping bag
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes
- Small sewing kit
- Collapsible water bottle
- Motion sickness tablets (for the road trip / any boat activities)

Notes

- Bring layers for cooler evenings and air-conditioned spaces.
- Keep travel documents, medication, and valuables in your carry-on or daypack.
